description_en: Issues a custom digital certificate with specified subject, subject alternative names (SANs), key usage, and extended key usage attributes
description_zh: 使用指定的证书主体名称、证书主题别名、密钥用法、扩展密钥用法颁发数字证书
kebab_example: aliyun cas create-custom-certificate --parent-identifier 1ed4068c-6f1b-6deb-8e32-3f8439a851cb --csr example-string --validity '相对时间：_●_1y_●_3m_●_7d_绝对时间：_●_2006-01-02T15:04:05Z_●_2006-01-02T15:04:05Z/2023-03-09T17:48:13Z' --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomCertificate

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the CA certificate
parameters.name: parent_identifier

parameters.help_en: The content of the CSR. You can generate a CSR using tools such as OpenSSL or Keytool. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42218.html
parameters.help_zh: CSR内容。您可以通过OpenSSL工具或者Keytool工具生成CSR。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42218.html
parameters.name: csr

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the certificate. This period cannot exceed the validity period of the instance. You can use relative time or absolute time.

Relative time: Supports years, months, and days.

Year - y

Month - m

Day - d

Absolute time: Uses GMT. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`

Specify the end time - $NotAfter

Specify the start and end times - $NotBefore/$NotAfter
parameters.help_zh:
证书有效期。不可超过实例有效期。支持使用相对时间和绝对时间。

相对时间：支持单位年、月、日。

年 - y
月 - m
日 - d

绝对时间：使用GMT时间。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`

指定结束时间 - $NotAfter
指定开始时间和结束时间 - $NotBefore/$NotAfter
parameters.name: validity

fields.help_en: If an extension is critical, its name is included in the criticals list
fields.help_zh: 控制扩展的 critical 标记。如果是必要参数，则criticals列表中包含参数名
fields.name: criticals

fields.help_en: The extended key usages
fields.help_zh: 扩展密钥用法。类型：List<String>，支持以下预定义名称和自定义 OID：
fields.name: extended_key_usages

fields.help_en: Content commitment. Formerly known as NonRepudiation. Allows the certificate key to be used for content commitment
fields.help_zh: 内容承诺（不可否认）  。原名称NonRepudiation。允许证书密钥用于内容承诺
fields.name: content_commitment

fields.help_en: Data encipherment
fields.help_zh: 数据加密
fields.name: data_encipherment

fields.help_en: When KeyAgreement is true, this marks that the certificate key can only be used for decryption
fields.help_zh: 在KeyAgreement为true时，用于标记该证书密钥只能用于解密
fields.name: decipher_only

fields.help_en: Digital signature. Allows the private key of the certificate to be used for digital signatures and the public key to be used to verify digital signatures
fields.help_zh: 数字签名。允许使用证书私钥进行数字签名，允许使用证书公钥验证数字签名
fields.name: digital_signature

fields.help_en: When KeyAgreement is true, this marks that the certificate key can only be used for encryption
fields.help_zh: 在KeyAgreement为true时，用于标记该证书密钥只能用于加密
fields.name: encipher_only

fields.help_en: Key agreement
fields.help_zh: 密钥协商
fields.name: key_agreement

fields.help_en: Key encipherment. Allows the certificate key to be used to encrypt other keys
fields.help_zh: 密钥加密。允许证书密钥加密保护其他密钥
fields.name: key_encipherment

fields.help_en: Non-repudiation. This has been renamed to ContentCommitment in the X.509 standard
fields.help_zh: 抗抵赖（与 contentCommitment 等价）。X.509标准中已更名为ContentCommitment
fields.name: non_repudiation

fields.help_en: The key usage
fields.help_zh: 密钥用法
fields.name: key_usage

fields.help_en:
The following values are allowed:

rfc822Name - Email address

dNSName - Domain name

uniformResourceIdentifier - Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)

iPAddress - IP address
fields.help_zh:
允许使用以下值：

otherName - 以 # 开头表示 hex-encoded ASN1，否则为 UTF8String
rfc822Name - Email地址
dNSName - 域名
directoryName - X.500 DN
uniformResourceIdentifier - 统一资源标识符（URI）
iPAddress - IP地址
registeredID - OID
fields.name: type

fields.example:
rfc822Name:
example.aliyundoc.com

dNSName:
learn.aliyundoc.com

uniformResourceIdentifier:
acs:ecs:regionid:15619224785*****:instance/i-bp1bzvz55uz27hf*****

iPAddress:
127.0.0.1
fields.help_en: A value that matches the specified Type
fields.help_zh:
符合Type定义的值。
otherName：以 # 开头表示 hex-encoded ASN1，否则为 UTF8String。
   otherName 特殊处理：值以 # 开头 → 去掉 #，hex 解码为 ASN1 结构（ASN1Primitive.fromByteArray）
否则 → 包装为 DERUTF8String
rfc822Name： Email 地址，如 user@example.com 
dNSName：域名，如 www.example.com 
directoryName： X.500 DN，如 CN=Test,O=Org   
uniformResourceIdentifier：URI，如 https://example.com   
iPAddress：IP 地址，如 192.168.1.1        
registeredID：OID，如 1.2.3.4
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The subject alternative names (SANs) of the certificate
fields.help_zh: 主题备用名称 (SAN)。类型：List<Extensions.SubjectAlternativeName>，每项包含 type（GeneralNameType 枚举）和 value（字符串）
fields.name: subject_alternative_names

fields.help_en: The certificate extensions
fields.help_zh: 证书扩展项
fields.name: extensions

fields.help_en: The custom serial number of the certificate. Must be a long integer
fields.help_zh: 自定义证书的序列号（必须是长整型）
fields.name: serial_number

fields.help_en: The common name of the certificate user
fields.help_zh: 证书使用者的通用名称
fields.name: common_name

fields.help_en: The country code. Use the two-letter country code from ISO 3166-1. For more information, see ISO (https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search/code/)
fields.help_zh: 国家代码。使用ISO 3166-1的二位国家代码。参考ISO (https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search/code/)
fields.name: country

fields.help_en:
The key of the custom property. It must comply with industry standards. Examples:

2.5.4.6: Country code

2.5.4.10: Organization

2.5.4.11: Organizational unit name

2.5.4.12: Title

2.5.4.3: Common name

2.5.4.9: Street

2.5.4.5: Serial number

2.5.4.7: Locality

2.5.4.8: State or province

1.3.6.1.4.1.37244.1.1: Matter certificate - Node ID

1.3.6.1.4.1.37244.1.5: Matter certificate - Fabric ID

1.3.6.1.4.1.37244.2.1: Matter certificate Vendor ID (VID)

1.3.6.1.4.1.37244.2.2: Matter certificate Product ID (PID)
fields.name: object_identifier

fields.help_en: The value of the custom property
fields.help_zh: 自定义属性属性值
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The custom subject properties of the certificate
fields.help_zh: 自定义证书的Subject属性
fields.name: custom_attributes

fields.help_en: The name of the city where the organization is located. Chinese characters and letters are supported
fields.help_zh: 组织机构所在城市的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
fields.name: locality

fields.help_en: The name of the organization
fields.help_zh: 组织机构名称
fields.name: organization

fields.help_en: The name of the department or branch within the organization
fields.help_zh: 组织机构下部门或分支的名称
fields.name: organization_unit

fields.help_en: The province or state where the organization is located
fields.help_zh:
<props="china">CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>
fields.name: state

fields.help_en: The certificate subject
fields.help_zh: 证书主体名称
fields.name: subject

parameters.name: api_passthrough

parameters.help_en:
Obtain the certificate immediately.

0 - Issue the certificate asynchronously.

1 - Issue the certificate immediately.

2 - Issue the certificate immediately and return the CA certificate chain
parameters.help_zh:
立即获取证书。

0 - 异步颁发证书。
1 - 立即颁发证书。
2 - 立即颁发证书并返回CA证书链
parameters.name: immediately

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include a CRL address.

0 - No

1 - Yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含CRL地址

0 - 否
1 - 是
parameters.name: enable_crl

fields.help_en: The tag key
fields.help_zh: 标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value
fields.help_zh: 标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html接口获取
parameters.name: resource_group_id

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
